shared.surfBiteReport: The Northwest Florida Fishing Report for July 24–31, 2026 describes surf conditions along the Emerald Coast as generally improved, with June grass clearing from many beach stretches — finding a grass-free section is the critical first step before committing to a spot. The hot bite in the surf zone has been whiting, targeted in the holes and troughs close to shore. Pompano have been present but inconsistent, showing up only sporadically rather than in reliable schools. Spanish mackerel, ladyfish, and a few bluefish are also in the mix for anglers willing to scout along the beach. No specific bait or rig detail was included in the indexed episode summary beyond the emphasis on locating clean-water structure near the first sandbar holes.
